ownHint: Critical roles/seats you are planning succession for. Only you edit your plans; managers above you and HR can read them — the people involved never see them.
teamHint: Read-only view of the succession plans owned by managers in your reporting line.
deleteConfirmMessage: Delete the succession plan for {{name}}? Its nominations go with it. This cannot be undone.
benchShortAria: Bench below target: {{n}} of {{target}} successors nominated
benchMetAria: Bench at target: {{n}} of {{target}} successors nominated
createHint: Pick a person from your reporting line and describe how critical their seat is. Successors are nominated on the plan afterwards.

event.benchDepthChanged: Target bench depth changed from {{from}} to {{to}}.
event.primaryDemoted: The nomination of {{name}} changed to secondary — a new primary was chosen.

closeReviewMessage: Closing this screen will not count as a review of the plan — the last-reviewed date stays unchanged.
closeReviewUnsaved: Your unsaved changes will also be discarded.
closedNote: This plan is closed — it stays browsable but can no longer be edited.
underBenchNote: The bench is below target: {{n}} of {{target}} successors nominated.
nominationHint: Nominate a candidate for this seat — anyone active in the organization, including cross-team candidates. The candidate is never notified.
developmentGoalsHint: Personal goals of the candidate linked to this nomination.
newGoalHint: The goal is created as a draft for the candidate and linked to this nomination. It appears to them like any other goal — nothing reveals the succession context.
deleteNominationConfirmMessage: Remove {{name}} from the bench? Linked goals are untouched.
primaryConfirmMessage: {{current}} is currently the primary successor on this plan. Making {{candidate}} primary will change the nomination of {{current}} to secondary.
closeConfirmMessage: Close this plan? It stays browsable but can never be edited again.
discardCreateMessage: The plan has not been created yet. Leaving now discards everything you entered.
discardChangesMessage: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
plansAuditHint: Every plan {{who}} is a party to — as the seat's person or as the owning manager. Access is recorded in the audit trail.

validation.itemRequired: The item must not be empty
validation.benchDepth: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}

error.permission: You are not allowed to modify this succession plan.
error.viewPermission: You are not allowed to view this succession plan.
error.notFound: This succession plan does not exist (or was deleted).
error.nominationNotFound: This nomination does not exist (or was deleted).
error.conflict: This conflicts with the plan's current state — an open plan for this person may already exist, the candidate may already be nominated, or the plan is closed.
error.invalid: The entered data is invalid. Check the fields and try again.
error.saveFailed: Saving failed. Check your connection and try again.
error.loadFailed: Failed to load the succession plan.
